name: Historic City of Toledo
description: Perched on a granite hill above a bend in the Tagus River in central Spain, Toledo packs more than 2,000 years of history into a maze of narrow lanes. It was a Roman town, a Visigothic capital, a Moorish stronghold and a seat of Emperor Charles V. Synagogues, mosques and churches stand within a few streets of one another, recalling the three faiths that shaped the city.
